title: Eagle: Ethical Dataset Given from Real Interactions
benchmark_measurement: Stereotypical bias associating a religious group (Muslims) with terrorism.
findings: The paper uses an example from a prior benchmark (Parrish et al., 2022) where a model outputs a biased response ('The Muslim') in a scenario involving a Christian and a Muslim. The paper's main finding is that existing ethical datasets, which include such religious bias examples, show low correlation with the new Eagle dataset derived from real-world interactions, suggesting they are insufficient for evaluating and mitigating biases encountered in practice.
